title: gEdit machines file
description: The machines file of gEdit (machines.json in the settings folder): how each of your machines reads programs, and which machine a profile uses when nothing else is chosen. gEdit itself checks every machine against its profile; this description lets another editor point out typing mistakes while you edit the file by hand.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The address of this description, so that an editor can check the file while you type. gEdit does not read it.

$version.title: File format version
$version.description: The version of the file format; gEdit writes 1. A file with a higher number comes from a newer gEdit and is read but never changed.

machines.title: Machines
machines.description: Your machines, at most 100. Each one says how its control reads the programs of one profile. A machine with a mistake is kept in the file and listed with the mistake, but it cannot be chosen until it is put right.

defaults.title: Default machines
defaults.description: The machine a profile's documents use when you choose none: the profile id, then the machine id. Example: { "fanuc-lathe": "lathe-2" }. An entry that names a machine that does not exist is ignored.

additionalProperties.title: Default machine
additionalProperties.description: The id of the machine, as written in its "id".

machine.title: Machine
machine.description: One machine: its id, its name, the profile of its programs, and the settings that differ from the profile's defaults.

id.title: Id
id.description: A short, fixed name gEdit remembers the machine by, for example "lathe-2": 1 to 64 characters of a to z, 0 to 9 and "-", starting with a letter or a digit. Change it and the documents that remember this machine forget it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name shown in gEdit, for example "Lathe 2, hall B": 1 to 64 characters, different from every other machine's name.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The id of the profile whose programs this machine runs, for example "fanuc-lathe". The machine can be chosen for documents of that profile and of every profile built on it.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Your own notes about the machine, at most 500 characters. gEdit does not read them.

machineParams.title: Settings
machineParams.description: Only what differs from the profile's defaults. Everything left out follows the profile. Which settings a machine may have depends on its profile.

numberInput.title: Number input
numberInput.description: How the control reads a number without a decimal point, for example whether X50 means 50 mm or 0.050 mm. null, or left out: as the profile's default says.

units.title: Units at power-on
units.description: The units the control starts in before a program says G20/G21 (or G70/G71): "mm" or "inch".

diameter.title: Diameter programming
diameter.description: On a lathe: "on" when X is written as a diameter, "off" when it is written as a radius. Only for profiles that have this setting.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: The machine's choice for each variant its profile offers, by the variant's id, for example { "gcodeSystem": "B" }. The choices are listed in the profile.

additionalProperties.title: Choice
additionalProperties.description: The value of one of the variant's choices, as written in the profile.

modalInitial.title: Codes in force at power-on
modalInitial.description: The code each modal group holds when the program starts, where the machine differs from the profile, for example { "feed": "G95" }. Only for the groups the profile offers; the code has to belong to that group.

additionalProperties.title: Code
additionalProperties.description: A code of the group, written as text, for example "G95".

extraAxes.title: Extra axes
extraAxes.description: Axes the machine builder named with more than one letter, for example AA or QQ, so that AA90 is read as an axis word. At most 16. Only for profiles that offer extra axes.

builderCodes.title: Machine builder codes
builderCodes.description: Codes the machine builder added, written as a list of codes and ranges, for example "G810-G829, G850". gEdit then names such a code as the builder's instead of an unknown code. At most 1000 characters; only for profiles that offer it, and only with the letters the profile names.

positiveDecimal.title: Increment
positiveDecimal.description: A number above zero written as text, with digits and at most one decimal point, for example "0.001" or "1". Text, so that 0.001 stays exactly 0.001.

numberReading.title: Reading
numberReading.description: "increment": a number without a decimal point counts steps of the increment (X50 is 0.050 mm with an increment of 0.001), one with a point is read as written. "calculator": every number as written. "scale": every number, with or without a point, times the increment.

numberClass.title: Reading of one kind of number
numberClass.description: Where the control reads this kind of number differently from lengths: its own reading and increment.

increment.title: Increment
increment.description: The increment of this kind of number: in mm for lengths and feeds in a metric program, in degrees for angles, in seconds for dwell times.

incrementInch.title: Increment in inch programs
incrementInch.description: The increment in an inch program. Only for lengths and feeds; angles and dwell times do not change with the units.

numberInput.title: Number input
numberInput.description: How the control reads the numbers of a program: one reading for lengths, and where angles, feeds or dwell times are read differently, their own. Example: { "mode": "increment", "incrementMm": "0.001" } reads X50 as 0.050 mm and X50. as 50 mm.

incrementMm.title: Increment in mm
incrementMm.description: The smallest step of a length in a metric program, in mm, for example "0.001". With "scale" it is the value of 1.

incrementInch.title: Increment in inch
incrementInch.description: The same for an inch program, in inch, for example "0.0001". Left out: a tenth of the metric increment.

incrementDeg.title: Increment in degrees
incrementDeg.description: The smallest step of an angle, in degrees, in metric and inch programs alike. Left out: the same digits as the metric increment.

incrementSec.title: Increment in seconds
incrementSec.description: The smallest step of a dwell time, in seconds. Left out: as the angle increment.

classes.title: Other kinds of number
classes.description: Where the control reads a kind of number differently from lengths, for example feeds always as written: { "feedPerMin": { "mode": "calculator" } }. The kinds are length, angle, feedPerMin, feedPerRev and dwell.

angle.title: Angles
angle.description: Rotary axis positions and other angles, in degrees.

feedPerMin.title: Feed per minute
feedPerMin.description: Feeds in mm (or inch) per minute.

feedPerRev.title: Feed per revolution
feedPerRev.description: Feeds in mm (or inch) per revolution, and thread leads.

userPattern.title: Pattern
userPattern.description: A search pattern (a regular expression) in gEdit's pattern language, at most 1000 characters. The pattern tester on the Machines page shows what it finds.

fileNameTemplate.title: File name template
fileNameTemplate.description: A file name in which {{stem}} stands for the common part of the names and {{channel}} for the channel's id, for example {{stem}}_CH{{channel}}.nc. Nothing else may stand in double braces.

waitCodeList.title: Codes
waitCodeList.description: A list of codes and ranges as you would write them, for example "M100-M199, M300" or "P1-9999".

channelList.title: Channels
channelList.description: Channels by their id or another spelling, at least one.

items.title: Channel
items.description: The id or another spelling of a channel of this machine.

whenAbsent.title: Without the channel word
whenAbsent.description: Which channels a wait waits for when its line does not name them: "none", "all", or "fixed" with a list, for example { "kind": "fixed", "channels": ["1", "2"] }.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: "none": no other channel. "all": every channel. "fixed": the channels listed.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: For "fixed": the channels, by their id or another spelling.

syncRule.title: Wait rule
syncRule.description: How gEdit finds the wait codes of the channels in a program, and which channels each wait waits for.

id.title: Id
id.description: A short name of the rule, different from the other rules of the machine. "stops-and-ends" is taken.

label.title: Label
label.description: The text gEdit shows for the rule's waits.

semantics.title: What is checked
semantics.description: "rendezvous": each wait meets the wait with the same number in the other channels. "count": only the number of waits must be the same on both sides. "ordered": the numbers only order the channels, smaller first, and may stand on one side only.

blocking.title: Waits
blocking.description: true: the control stops here until the partners arrive, and gEdit checks it. false: a mark that does not stop, shown but not checked.

answers.title: Answers a wait
answers.description: true for a mark that does not stop but answers a wait of another channel with the same number (Siemens SETM).

samePartners.title: Same channels on both sides
samePartners.description: true when two waits that meet must name the same channels, both with the channel word or both without (the Fanuc waiting M-code with P).

markSeparator.title: Separator between marks
markSeparator.description: For a pattern whose number is a list of marks, for example SETM(5,6): the text between them, for example ",".

markValues.title: Allowed mark numbers
markValues.description: The lowest and highest number a mark may have, for example { "min": 0, "max": 99 }. A number outside is a warning.

min.title: Lowest
min.description: The lowest number, a whole number.

max.title: Highest
max.description: The highest number, a whole number, not below the lowest.

withCodes.title: Codes that need a common mark
withCodes.description: Codes that may only stand at a mark that the other channel has too, for example "S, M03-M05, G96" for the spindle commands at an Okuma P code.

sharesWaitsWith.title: Shares its waits with
sharesWaitsWith.description: The id of a rule that checks by count and whose waits stand in the same channels, for example the Okuma M100 beside the P codes.

match.title: What it matches
match.description: How a wait is found in a line: a list of "codes", the start of a code ("prefix"), or a pattern ("regex").

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: "codes": a list such as M100-M199. "prefix": the start of a code, such as M1. "regex": a pattern.

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: For "codes": the wait codes as a list, for example "M100-M199" or "P1-9999".

prefix.title: Start of the code
prefix.description: For "prefix": a letter and up to seven letters or digits, for example M1.

idDigits.title: Digits of the number
idDigits.description: For "prefix": how many digits follow the start of the code, from 1 to 8, for example { "min": 2, "max": 2 }.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: For "regex": a pattern for the wait, with a part (?<mark>…) for its number unless the rule checks by count.

max.title: Most
max.description: The most digits, 1 to 8, not below the fewest.

partners.title: Who it waits for
partners.description: Which channels a wait waits for: "all", a "fixed" list, the value of a "word" on the wait's line (P12), or a "line" pattern.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: "all": every channel. "fixed": the channels listed. "word": an address word on the wait's line names them. "line": a pattern on the wait's line names them.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: For "fixed": the channels, by their id or another spelling.

address.title: Address letter
address.description: For "word": the letter of the word that names the channels, for example P.

decode.title: How the number is read
decode.description: "digits": each digit is a channel (P12 = channels 1 and 2). "bitmask": a sum of 1, 2, 4, … (P3 = channels 1 and 2). "split": a list split at the separator.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: For "line": a pattern on the wait's line with a part (?<channels>…) that names the channels.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: For "line": the text between the channels of a list, for example ",".

whenAbsent.title: Without the channel word
whenAbsent.description: For "word" and "line": which channels a wait waits for when its line does not name them. Left out: none.

channelParams.title: Channels
channelParams.description: How the machine's channels (turrets, paths) are laid out in its programs and which codes are its waits. Leave the block out for a machine with one channel.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: "single-file": all channels in one program, in sections. "multi-file": one program per channel.

list.title: Channels
list.description: The channels, 2 to 32, in the order gEdit shows them.

items.title: Channel
items.description: One channel: its id, its name and the other ways programs write it.

id.title: Id
id.description: 1 to 16 lower-case letters, digits, "-" or "_", starting with a letter or a digit, for example "1" or "a".

name.title: Name
name.description: The name gEdit shows, 1 to 32 characters, for example "Turret A".

aliases.title: Other spellings
aliases.description: Other ways programs name this channel, for example G13 or WAIT_K1, at most 8, each 1 to 32 characters.

items.title: Spelling
items.description: One other spelling of the channel.

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: One program per channel only: this channel's own file name, with {{stem}} and {{channel}}, for example {{stem}}_GS.MPF.

sectionStart.title: Section start
sectionStart.description: One program only: a pattern for the line that starts a channel's section, for example the line with G13 or G14. A part (?<channel>…) names the channel.

sectionSeparator.title: Separator in the section start
sectionSeparator.description: One program only: the character between several channels named by one section start, for example "/". One character that is not a letter, a digit or a blank.

sectionEnd.title: Section end
sectionEnd.description: One program only: a pattern for the line that ends a section. Left out: a section runs to the next start.

fileName.title: File name pattern
fileName.description: One program per channel only: a pattern for the file name with a part (?<stem>…) for the common part and a part (?<channel>…) for the channel.

fileNameFor.title: File name of another channel
fileNameFor.description: One program per channel only: the file name of another channel's program, with {{stem}} and {{channel}}, for example {{stem}}_CH{{channel}}.nc.

marker.title: Channel marker
marker.description: One program per channel only: a pattern for a line near the top that names the program's channel, with a part (?<channel>…), for example a header comment.

syncMarks.title: Wait rules
syncMarks.description: How the waits between the channels are found, at most 32 rules.

stopsAndEndsWait.title: Stops and ends count as waits
stopsAndEndsWait.description: true when every program stop and end also waits for the other channels.

extraAxis.title: Extra axis
extraAxis.description: One axis the machine builder named with more than one letter.

name.title: Name
name.description: 2 to 8 capital letters, for example "AA". It may not be a word the profile already reads.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: "linear" for an axis that moves in mm or inch, "rotary" for one that turns in degrees.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: The machine's rapid rates, top feed and tool-change time, for the time estimate and the cycle forms. Leave out what you do not know; nothing is assumed.

units.title: Units
units.description: The units of every length and rate in this block: "mm" (mm and mm/min) or "inch" (inch and in/min). Needed once a rate or a length is set.

rapid.title: Rapid rates
rapid.description: The rapid rate of each axis per minute, for example { "X": 30000, "Z": 30000 }: a linear axis in the block's units, at most 200,000 mm/min, a rotary axis in degrees per minute.

rapidKind.title: How rapid moves
rapidKind.description: "straight": all axes on one line. "per-axis": each axis at its own rate, the move ends with the last axis. Left out: straight.

maxFeed.title: Top feed
maxFeed.description: The highest cutting feed per minute, in the block's units, at most 200,000 mm/min. A higher programmed feed is counted at this one.

toolChange.title: Tool change time
toolChange.description: Seconds one tool change takes, 0 to 600.

peckRetract.title: Peck retract
peckRetract.description: How far a high-speed peck drilling cycle (G73) lifts, in the block's units, at most 100 mm. Only fills in the forms.

peckClearance.title: Peck clearance
peckClearance.description: How far above the last depth a deep peck drilling cycle (G83) comes back down to, in the block's units, at most 100 mm. Only fills in the forms.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: What the machine may not exceed: the top speed of each spindle and the travel of each axis.

units.title: Units
units.description: The units of the travel: "mm" or "inch". Needed once a travel is set.

spindle.title: Top spindle speeds
spindle.description: The top speed of each spindle in rpm: "main" for the plain S word, otherwise the speed address, for example { "main": 4000, "S2": 3000 }.

additionalProperties.title: Top speed
additionalProperties.description: In rpm, above 0 and at most 200,000.

travel.title: Travel
travel.description: The lowest and highest position of each axis in machine coordinates, for example { "X": { "min": -300, "max": 300 } }: a linear axis in the block's units, a rotary axis in degrees.

additionalProperties.title: Travel of one axis
additionalProperties.description: The lowest (min) and highest (max) position, min below max, each between -100,000 and 100,000.
